pages.text: [#](53341a)An effigy shaped to resemble a person and bound to them through a taglock carries a thread of the sympathy that connects all things. What happens to the effigy tends to happen to its subject — and it works in both directions.[#]()
pages.title: Poppets

pages.text: [#](53341a)Bind a poppet by right-clicking it with a filled taglock. Then place it on a Poppet Shelf, or carry a protection poppet in your own inventory.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Voodoo Poppet is the foundation of this practice. From it, other forms follow.[#]()
[#](53341a)Protection poppets are consumed when triggered — they give themselves to prevent something worse happening to you.[#]()
pages.title: On Protection

pages.text: [#](53341a)Death, Earth, Water, Fire, Hunger; each covers a different category of misfortune, and Voodoo Protection counters hostile poppet workings.[#]() [#](53341a)Keep spares. The shelf holds nine.[#]()
